column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Won't Listen To Her Best Friend
Phew... We finally got Ayase under control, but it's already night time.
...So, let me get this straight, why are you and Ayase on good terms?
...Just where did you see us being on good terms back there?
Tch... so annoying...
Did you just say something?
...Not really.
Well then, have you remembered anything? Ayase worked extremely hard for the sake of obtaining that figurine, you know?
...I can't remember anything at all. What was that Meruru event you mentioned earlier? Isn't it just stupid?
I've already said you were there too!
Uuu... Aaaaah... T-That's impossible...
Well, there's indeed no other word to describe yourself back then except "stupid"...
Don't call me stupid.
N-No, that's what you said yourself...
Even if that's the case, it's irritating coming from you.
...That's rather harsh.
T-That's a lie! There's no reason for me to go crazy over that kind of event!
No, you're overly excited right now too!
A-Anyway, calm down! Come on, take deep breaths.
Hu...ha... Hu...ha...
I-I can't do it. I can't calm down at all...
Kirino, the past can't be changed. It's an obstacle that cannot be overcome.
Hah, hah..
H-Hey... So that means... I'm the same as those disgusting otaku that are seen a lot on television?
No, you're different from them!
Among the otaku crowd full of perspiration and grease, to have the figure of a spirited middle school girl wildly dancing...
You were clearly conspicuous even among those otaku.
In other words... You were very out of place.
Don't say that with such confidence!!
It's all right, back then you were...
You were on a level above those guys, so absurdly gross that you had no equal.
Stop messing with me!!!
I wish I could deny it too, but the truth is the truth.
I-I can't take it anymore... I have no choice but to commit seppuku if that's how things are...
Hold it! I know people who are much more shameful than you!
M-More than me!?
A manly person who would start playing H-games at anytime, anywhere on the darkest streets. A fujoshi that lets her imagination run wild upon seeing a
fork and spoon...
Hmph, you're just a beginner compared to them.
...D-Don't compare me with those kind of people!
I really recommend that you don't do that.
D-Don't stop me.
However, if I don't stop you now, you might be falsely portrayed as the girl who committed suicide due to her grief of being unable to recover her
memories of Meruru, and be worshiped by the otaku community, you know?
Do you really want to be a legend for eternity within the otaku community?
No! I take back what I just said!
No...! I-I can't take it anymore...!
Uuuu... Spare me already....
I-I can't find any words for such a pitiful response...
